sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). Despite a recent loss, Sandbach's form remains strong with seven wins and one draw from their last six matches. They then travel away to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October (KO 15:00), seeking to maintain their first-place position.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday 3 October and then face Wednesfield Community away on Saturday 10 October, looking to close a two-point gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth are at home to Eccleshall on Saturday 3 October, while Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community the same day—both third and fourth in the table will be keen to keep pace. Bilston Town (5th) host Foley Meir at home on Saturday 3 October and travel to face Crewe on Saturday 10 October. Barnton play Shawbury United away on Saturday 10 October as they sit mid-table in 7th. New Mills face two fixtures: hosting Market Drayton Town on Saturday 3 October and visiting Telford Town on Saturday 10 October, both outside the top half. Allscott Heath, currently 11th, host Crewe at home on Saturday 3 October before visiting leaders Sandbach on Saturday 10 October. Bottom-placed Widnes Town travel to Brereton Social on Saturday 3 October and host Market Drayton Town on Saturday 10 October, looking to escape their winless run. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Sandbach United on Saturday 10 October after hosting Crewe away on Saturday 3 October. Brereton Social face Widnes Town at home on Saturday 3 October, then welcome Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October (KO 19:45) before visiting Allscott Heath on Saturday 10 October—a busy schedule for the struggling side. Shawbury United's recent form of five consecutive losses sees them host Barnton on Saturday 10 October after visiting Alsager Town away on Saturday 3 October. Foley Meir and Eccleshall complete the Saturday 3 October card; Telford Town and Sandbach's match against Cheadle Heath round out the Saturday 10 October fixtures.
